entities.summary: Naval Air Station Patuxent River, also known as NAS Pax River, is a United States naval air station in St. Mary’s County, Maryland on the Chesapeake Bay near the mouth of the Patuxent River. Naval Air Station Patuxent River is a research institute in Americas, established in 1942. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
